name: clerk-otp

frames.best_why: All six cells hold digits and every cell carries the cyan glow, showing the completed code.

tagline: Six code cells fill themselves one digit at a time with cyan glows.
summary: A small dark verification card with six code boxes that type a random number into one cell after another, glow cyan on the current cell, flash together and repeat.
appearance: A rounded dark card with six square cells in a row near the top, each a subtle gradient tile holding a pale grey digit. The active cell has a cyan outline and inner glow. A small white title and two lines of grey copy sit at the lower left.
behaviour: A random six-digit code types itself in, advancing about every 400ms; the current cell glows cyan, the whole row flashes once the last digit lands, then the digits fade and the loop starts again after a pause.
demo_content: Title Multifactor Authentication with copy about self-serve multifactor settings enforced at sign-in.
search_phrases: pin code boxes with cyan glow
use_when: A sign-in or two-factor screen needs a lively placeholder or hero for the verification-code step.
avoid_when: Real code entry: the digits are random and uneditable, so it cannot verify anything on its own.
customise: Title, description, loop delay and hover-gating come through props; the six-cell layout, gradient tiles, cyan glow and timings are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Six animated spans on a timer; no canvas and no per-frame loop.

a11y.note: The digits are decorative motion with no input semantics, labels or live announcement of the code.

props.name: cardDescription
props.default: "Each user's self-serve multifactor settings are enforced au

issues: It looks like a real verification field but has no inputs, verify action or error state.
polish_why: Tidy little card and a satisfying glow; it is a looping demo rather than a usable field.
title: Animated OTP Card
